fix.explanation: NPCI set a 0.4% MDR on eligible person-to-merchant UPI payments above Rs 2,000, due from 15 October 2026, and on 13 October deferred it until after Diwali, with the new date to be announced separately. Payments up to Rs 2,000 and person-to-person transfers stay free, while railways, telecom, insurance and fuel pay a flat Rs 5 on payments above Rs 2,000. Source: Free Press Journal (NPCI data), 2 Nov 2026.
